name: Protoclone
summary: A full-body anthropomorphic android from Clone Robotics built on an artificial musculoskeletal system: a polymer skeleton (modeled on 206 bones) moved by over 1,000 fluid-driven 'Myofiber' artificial muscles, with 500+ sensors. The 2025 Protoclone V1 is pneumatically powered and suspended from a rig — it cannot yet stand on its own — but it is one of the most complete biomimetic humanoid bodies attempted; Clone plans to move to hydraulic actuation.
notable: Over 1,000 artificial muscles over a synthetic skeleton
~200 DOF, 500+ sensors; among the most biomimetic android bodies built
